NAME: PYAMINI

CLASS: CSE-01 [F_{2}]

IDNO: N240046

BRANCH: CSE

To learn the fundamental C programming by implementing programs using variables, operators, conditional statements, loops, and switch statement

Programs performed:

1) Even or odd This program checks whether a given number is even or odd using the modulus ( $ \% $) operator and an if-else statement

2) Positive, Negative, or zero This program determines whether a number is +ve, -ve, or zero using relative or real operators and an if-else-if ladder.

3) Character type check This program identifies whether the entered character is an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, or special character.

4) Leap year check This program checks if a given year is a Leap year by applying the standard leap year conditions with the nested if statements.

5) memory allocation. Data types: This program displays the memory site of different data types using site of operator.

6) Menu-Based Arithmetic operational This program performs arithmetic operations, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus, &

Power using switch statement

7) Swap without temporary variable This program

---

Swaps two members using by storing one value using arithmetic operations without using an extra variable

Swaps two numbers

using arithmetic operations without using an extra variable.

8. Swap using temporary variable: This swaps two numbers by string one value in temporary variable.

9) Perfect square check: This program checks whether a number is a perfect square without using square function.

10) Student Grade calculation. This program leads a Student's marks and displays, the corresponding grade using nested if-else statement or if checkholder.

11) Extended menu: Based calculator This program improves the calculator by handling invalid menu choices and division by zero.

12) Largest of three numbers: This program finds the largest among three numbers using only the conditional (ternary) operator without using if-else statement.

13) Grade point to letter grade: This program is done by using switch statement and some relational checks.

Concepts Used:

Operators Used: 1) Arithmetic operators 2) Logical operators

3) Ternary operators

Control statements: 1) If 2) nested if 3) switch case

Looping statements: 7) For loop 2) while loop

Conclusion:

All the programs were implemented, compiled, executed successfully, and the expected outputs were obtained.

extraction.objective_of_lab: To learn the fundamental C programming by implementing programs using variables, operators, conditional statements, loops, and switch statement

P1.problem_understanding: This program checks whether a given number is even or odd using the modulus ( %) operator and an if-else statement
P1.logic_approach: The program uses the modulus operator to determine if the remainder of the number divided by 2 is 0 or not. If it is 0, the number is even; otherwise, it is odd.
P1.what_i_observed: The program correctly identified whether the given number is even or odd.

P2.problem_understanding: This program determines whether a number is positive, negative, or zero using relative or real operators and an if-else-if ladder.
P2.logic_approach: The program uses the comparison operators to check if the number is greater than, less than, or equal to zero.
P2.what_i_observed: The program correctly identified whether the given number is positive, negative, or zero.

P3.problem_understanding: This program identifies whether the entered character is an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, or special character.
P3.logic_approach: The program uses the character comparison operators to check if the character is an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, or special character.
P3.what_i_observed: The program correctly identified whether the entered character is an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, or special character.

P4.problem_understanding: This program checks if a given year is a Leap year by applying the standard leap year conditions with the nested if statements.
P4.logic_approach: The program uses the leap year conditions to check if the year is divisible by 4, but not divisible by 100 unless it is also divisible by 400.
P4.what_i_observed: The program correctly identified whether the given year is a Leap year.

P5.problem_understanding: This program displays the memory site of different data types using site of operator.
P5.logic_approach: The program uses the sizeof() operator to determine the memory size of different data types.
P5.what_i_observed: The program correctly displayed the memory site of different data types.

P6.problem_understanding: This program performs arithmetic operations, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus, & Power using switch statement
P6.logic_approach: The program uses a switch statement to perform different arithmetic operations based on the user's choice.
P6.what_i_observed: The program correctly performed arithmetic operations.

P7.problem_understanding: This program swaps two numbers without using a third/temporary variable.
P7.logic_approach: The program uses arithmetic operations to swap two numbers without using a third variable.
P7.what_i_observed: The program correctly swapped two numbers without using a third variable.

P8.problem_understanding: This swaps two numbers using a temporary variable.
P8.logic_approach: The program uses a temporary variable to swap two numbers.
P8.what_i_observed: The program correctly swapped two numbers using a temporary variable.

P9.problem_understanding: This program checks whether a given number is a perfect square without using the sqrt() library function.
P9.logic_approach: The program uses a loop to check if the square of the integer part of the square root of the number is equal to the number.
P9.what_i_observed: The program correctly checked whether a given number is a perfect square.

P10.problem_understanding: This program leads a Student's marks and displays, the corresponding grade using nested if-else statement or if checkholder.
P10.logic_approach: The program uses nested if-else statements to determine the grade based on the student's marks.
P10.what_i_observed: The program correctly calculated and displayed the student's grade.

P11.problem_understanding: Extended menu: Based calculator This program improves the calculator by handling invalid menu choices and division by zero.
P11.logic_approach: The program uses a switch statement to handle different menu choices and checks for division by zero.
P11.what_i_observed: The program correctly handled invalid menu choices and division by zero.

P12.problem_understanding: Largest of three numbers: This program finds the largest among three numbers using only the conditional (ternary) operator without using if-else statement.
P12.logic_approach: The program uses the ternary operator to find the largest among three numbers.
P12.what_i_observed: The program correctly found the largest among three numbers.

P13.problem_understanding: Grade point to letter grade: This program is done by using switch statement and some relational checks.
P13.logic_approach: The program uses a switch statement to convert a grade point to a letter grade based on the grade point.
P13.what_i_observed: The program correctly converted a grade point to a letter grade.
